name: the character
short: The recurring character: a flat-2D cartoon young man, same in every scene: dark wavy hair, large white oval eyes, light skin, charcoal crew-neck tee, dark navy straight jeans, white low-top sneakers. Same face, hair, outfit, proportions and colors every scene.
style_short: Flat-2D cartoon, clean medium-weight outlines, flat colors, full-bleed simple flat-color background that matches the setting, warm palette. Not a stickman, not photorealistic, no 3D, no anime.
sheet_long: A friendly flat-2D cartoon young adult man: dark brown wavy hair (short sides, fuller wavy top), large white oval eyes with black pupils, thin dark eyebrows, a minimal small nose and a simple smile, small rounded ears, light peachy-tan skin. Slim, slightly broad-shouldered build roughly 4.5 heads tall with simple mitten-style rounded hands. He wears a short-sleeve charcoal crew-neck t-shirt, dark navy straight-leg jeans and white low-top sneakers, with a light gray contact shadow beneath his feet. Clean flat-2D cartoon style, consistent medium-weight black outlines, flat color fills, restrained warm palette.
